production.note: US model years. First: the history panel in Ford's 2004 brochure reads "2003 SVT MUSTANG COBRA 390 horsepower supercharged 4.6-liter dohc V8 Traction control standard Production: 13,493 units (est.)". Last: Torque News (Patrick Rall, 6 February 2012) says "the 2004 model year would be the final year for the F150 Lightning, the SVT Mustang Cobra and the SVT Focus" (torquenews-svt-20-years); Ford Muscle (Bradley Iger) says "The 2003-2004 Cobra was the final SVT-developed Mustang" (fordmuscle-2003-cobra). The SN95 SVT Cobra is split by year range because its rating changed too much for one figure across the generation; this record covers only the supercharged 2003-2004 cars.

body.note: Ford: "coupe or convertible body styles"; curb weights are given for both.

configuration.note: 'Longitudinally mounted, 90-degree V8, cast iron block with aluminum heads'

displacementL.note: 4,601 cc ('4,601cc; 280 cu. in.'; bore x stroke '90.2mm x 90.0mm')

aspiration.note: 'Eaton™ Corporation Generation IV Roots-type supercharger with water-to-air intercooler'

fuel.note: Inferred from Ford's description of a supercharged 4.6-liter DOHC V8; the brochure text read does not state a fuel grade.

drivetrain.note: Inferred: the driveline section describes only a rear axle ('8.8-in. ring gear with 3.55:1 limited-slip differential, aluminum case') and the 'independent rear suspension (IRS)'.

transmission.note: 'TTC T-56 6-speed manual', the only transmission. Ford Muscle also describes "a Tremec T-56 six-speed manual gearbox" (fordmuscle-2003-cobra).

powerHp.note: 2004 model. Horsepower row. Quote: "390 @ 6,000 rpm" (torque row "390 @ 3,500 rpm"). The same brochure's history panel gives the 2003 car the same rating: "2003 SVT MUSTANG COBRA 390 horsepower supercharged 4.6-liter dohc V8". The rating did not change between the two model years.

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 6-speed manual (the only transmission), 2004 model. Curb weight row, coupe. Quote: "3,665 lb. (1,662 kg)"; convertible "3,780 lb. (1,715 kg)". The reference year is 2004 rather than the 2003 launch year because Ford's 2003 SVT Mustang Cobra brochure (auto-brochures.com, Ford_US MustangCobra_2003.pdf) could not be read (HTTP 429 on every attempt), so no 2003 manufacturer weight was opened. The 390 hp rating applies to both years.
